lines.1: The bell had rung for battle.
lines.2: The executive committee was full of aggressive types.
lines.3: Fighting had probably broken out somewhere already.
lines.4: Rather than make an aggressive move myself, it would be smarter to let them thin the field first.
lines.5: But I wanted to avoid fighting the Princess if at all possible.
lines.6: 「The Princess, huh? Then I'm going all out!」
lines.10: Yashi leaped aside to dodge Kinu's shot.
lines.11: Kinu's excellent tracking vision made her shots precise, while Yashi's nearsightedness put her at a disadvantage fighting at night.
lines.12: 「You're pretty quick, but you can't keep running forever.」
lines.14: Yashi crouched and fired several shots in succession.
lines.15: But they were only enough to keep Kinu at bay.
lines.17: 「Looks like your eyes still haven't adjusted to the dark.」
lines.18: 「You knew that, so you lured me onto the field...」
lines.19: 「Of course I did. Now give it up and die!」
lines.20: A precise volley came at her.
lines.22: Yashi rolled along the ground to evade it.
lines.23: 「Too desperate to care how you look, huh? Suits you!」
lines.24: Yashi decided a little dirt was less humiliating than the stain of defeat.
lines.25: Red bolts struck where she had been half a second earlier.
lines.27: There was nothing on the open field she could use as cover.
lines.28: Nagomi Yashi had completely underestimated Kinu Kanisawa.
lines.30: Even as she rolled, she remembered to scoop up a stone from the field.
lines.32: She immediately hurled it at Kinu.
lines.33: But Kinu's owl-like eyesight let her dodge it with the slightest of movements.
lines.34: 「Cheap tricks from a small fry! I'll put one right through your head! I win!」
lines.38: Yashi used her gun as a shield to block the shot.
lines.39: She blocked it because Kinu really had called her shot.
lines.40: 「Not bad, using your gun as a shield. But next time, I won't tell you where I'm aiming.」
lines.41: 「...Then I'll just have to risk everything on one shot...」
lines.43: Her plan was to risk a mutual kill.
lines.44: 「Even if we fire together, I'm confident I can dodge yours.」
lines.47: Kinu leveled her barrel with a click.
lines.52: A hail of shots rained down from above toward Kinu.
lines.54: Kinu froze, realizing there was no way to dodge.
lines.60: 「She escaped... I hoped to take out both at once, but Yashi is surprisingly quick.」
lines.61: 「No matter. With her poor eyesight, I can kill Yashi whenever I please. Taking down the nimble Kanisawa is enough for now.」
lines.63: 「...I thought she would last longer than that. Pathetic.」
lines.65: 「We're inside the school, so this place counts too, right?」
lines.67: 「While I'm here, I'd like to buy some information. Tell me where Yoppi is.」
